name: GDIntercept Plus
description: Adds a + button to GDIntercept for drafting and sending your own requests. Also opens from anywhere with a keybind.

open_composer.name: Open Request Composer
open_composer.description: Opens the New Request window from anywhere (the + button in GDIntercept opens the same window).

timeout.name: Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: How long to wait for a response before giving up.

preview-chars.name: Response Preview Length
preview-chars.description: How many characters of the response to show in the window. Use Copy to get the whole response.
